notes.title: Happy Wattle Week!
notes.content:
It's a wonderful time of the year where we get to celebrate the changing of seasons and the arrival of our favourite yellow flower, wattle.

For some people who don't know, wattle ([url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Acacia]Acacia[/url]) is a type of bush/scrub and is native to Africa and Australia. We have lots of different types here in Australia and one of them in particular (Acacia paradoxa) features quite a lot in Paperbark.

Each year on [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wattle_Day]September 1st[/url], we put some time aside to appreciate all of the beautiful yellow flowers coming into bloom around us.

We like this time oh year a lot and because of this [b]we have put Paperbark on sale[/b]. We hope you can appreciate the wonder that is wattle as well! ːwombathappyː

Happy Wattle [strike]Day[/strike] Week everyone!

- Paper House

notes.title: Paperbark - Hotfix 21/12
notes.content:
We've just sent out a small update for Mac and Windows to fix a couple of small known issues.

- Fixed a visual issue when dragging library stickers.
- Fixed a rare case where the cicada sticker would not unlock after finding the final cicada.
- Fixed an macOS issue where the game would sometimes hang on the Paper House splash screen.
- Increased the 'Wombat Rush' achievement time from 16min to 18min. To bring it's difficulty in line with other achievements.

Thanks again for playing!

- Paper House
